paragraphs.text: The Goblin Wars were a series of military campaigns that took place during the final decades of the Dark Age on Terisiare , Dominaria . The wars represented a major turning point in the region's history, both militarily and socially, as it involved the systematic targeting of goblin and orc forces that threatened human settlements. Led by the young warrior Tivadar of Thorn and supported by the sorcerer Rasputin Dreamweaver , the campaigns not only altered the balance of power between human and nonhuman factions but also influenced the mission and priorities of the Church of Tal , shifting its focus away from internal persecution toward external defense.

Having grown up amid the Church of Tal 's witch hunts, Tivadar of Thorn became the leader of the Knights of Thorn during the part of the Dark Age on Dominaria . Just thirteen years old when he was recruited as a prison guard just before the Battle of Pitdown in 430 AR , Tivadar disagreed with the infighting between the various human factions, seeing the massing goblins , not magic , as the real source of danger against humankind.

In a controversial move, Tivadar was joined by the sorcerer Rasputin Dreamweaver , and together they established a unit of strong warriors that took the fight to the goblins. This campaign was a success, and Tivadar's rising popularity contributed to a shift in the mission of the Church of Tal, moving away from hunting sorcerers and witches and focusing more directly on the threats from enemies to all humankind. He led a major campaign against the goblins and orcs of Terisiare alongside Rasputin Dreamweaver .
It is not known precisely when the Goblin Wars took place, but Tivadar survived, and later wrote a history of the wars.
